question: How does daily abstention from food affect aging and death?
premises: Age and death are the conditions in question
A future overcoming of them is stated
inference: Through daily abstention from food, one will go beyond aging and death.
uncertainties: The precise sense of gamiṣyate with vayo mṛtyuṃ may mean overcoming or passing beyond death.
plain_english: By abstaining from food day by day, one will overcome aging and death.
